items.quote_text: Trade has been a great engine of post-war growth. All have gained from the greater freedom of trade and payments. Freer trade has meant lower prices, more competition and faster growth. And every consumer has benefited.
items.reviewer_notes: Recent production pairing: assess whether generic capitalism/socialism imagery directly illustrates free trade.
